resources.string: Hear who\'s singing at your place
HONE turns your phone, or the security camera you already have, into a nature listener.
Rewards from this app go to the person who invited you (%1$s) until you create your own wallet.
Rewards from this app go to the HONE community pool until you create your own wallet.
Already run HONE? Import an existing key
Please verify your email so you can sign in on another phone.
Welcome, %1$s. Let\'s find out who\'s singing at your place.
Welcome. Let\'s find out who\'s singing at your place.
Looking for cameras on your Wi-Fi…
Add a camera: we found 1 camera on your Wi-Fi: %1$s.
Add a camera: we found %1$d cameras on your Wi-Fi.
We didn\'t find a camera on your Wi-Fi.
Connect this phone to the same Wi-Fi as your camera, then try again.
The same ones you use in your camera app. They stay on this phone, locked.
Listening to your camera for a few seconds…
Your camera hears everything from tiny songbirds to owls.
Your camera hears most birds well.
Your camera hears low sounds well, like owls, doves, frogs and nightjars. Perfect for night listening.
This camera doesn\'t send sound. Check that its microphone is turned on in your camera app, then try again.
That username or password didn\'t work. Try again.
We couldn\'t connect to this camera. Make sure it is on and on the same Wi-Fi.
We only use sound, never video. Anyone talking is deleted instantly.
I\'ve checked local rules and want to start.
Listening… We\'ll tell you when we hear your first bird.
Your camera station listens while this phone is charging and on Wi-Fi.
Paused: plug in the phone and connect to Wi-Fi to listen.
Can\'t reach the camera. Trying again soon.
First bird! A %1$s was calling at %2$s.
Last night: %1$d species, %2$d calls. %3$d new to your list.
Rarest this month at your place: %1$s.
Morning summary of last night\'s birds
Android turned off HONE\'s microphone in the background. Tap to open HONE and keep listening for birds.
Battery is at %1$d%%. Bird listening is paused until you plug in your phone.
Battery is at %1$d%% even though it is charging. Try a stronger charger so HONE can keep listening.
On: 60%% for local birds, 70%% when the local list is unknown, 85%% for rare ones. Off: 70%% for all. Heard twice in 15 minutes always publishes.
Birds in your area, from every phone and camera listening nearby.
Can\'t load birds around here right now. Check your internet, or turn on location.
Nothing here yet. Keep listening: birds show up after a few days.
Help improve bird ID: share your yes/no answers.
Off unless you turn it on. Only the bird, the score and your answer are sent, never sound.
